Sandbox_StayWithMe_RelationshipGainMulti: Scales how fast friendship and romance grow from all sources. Applied after the daily caps and only to gains, never to losses. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_DailyFriendCap_toolti: Base friendship gained per day from talking, deeds and gifts before tier and relaxed bonuses. Default 6.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_DailyRomanceCap_toolt: Base romance gained per day before tier and relaxed bonuses. Only applies once romance is open. Default 3.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_GiftAffectionMultipli: Scales how much affection a given gift item is worth, before the daily gift cap. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_DailyGiftCapFriend_to: Base friendship that gifts can add per day, before tier bonuses. Separate from the talk cap. Default 3.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_DailyGiftCapRomance_t: Base romance that gifts can add per day, before tier bonuses. Separate from the talk cap. Default 1.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_RomanceRequirementFri: Friendship she needs before romance can open (0-100). Default 30.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_RomanceRequirementDay: Days she must have known you before romance can open. Default 2.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_RelationshipLossOnHit: Friendship lost when you hit her and the per-player 'hits matter' setting is on. Romance loss scales at five eighths of this value. 0 = no loss. Default 8.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_CarryCapacityBonus_to: Flat bonus to her carry capacity on top of the Strength-based value (0-20). Default 0.
Sandbox_StayWithMe_MoodEffectMultiplier_: Scales how much talking and her presence relieve boredom, unhappiness, stress, anger and pain. 1.0 = default.
